data.notes: December is unusually strong for Bangkok travelers: stadium-scale pop, Pattaya/Chonburi destination festivals, circuit parties, and a steady underground club calendar all overlap.

events.title: Tomorrowland Thailand 2026
events.summary: Tomorrowland Thailand stages its first full-scale Asian festival at Wisdom Valley from 11–13 December 2026. The official lineup page confirms artists including Martin Garrix, Alan Walker, Vini Vici, Kevin de Vries, Lilly Palmer, and Eli & Fur b2b Yotto.

events.title: BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN BANGKOK
events.summary: BTS bring their ARIRANG world tour to Rajamangala National Stadium for three Bangkok dates: 3, 5, and 6 December 2026. ThaiTicketMajor lists the run as sold out/official ticketed dates.

events.title: Wonderfruit 2026
events.venueName: The Fields at Siam Country Club
events.summary: Wonderfruit returns to The Fields near Pattaya from 3–7 December 2026, combining music, art, wellness, food, and culture. Confirmed 2026 programming includes electronic and house-leaning artists such as Gerd Janson, Nightmares on Wax, Jane Fitz, Nicolas Lutz, Sweely, and DOTT across its venue pages.

events.title: WHITE PARTY BANGKOK: AmaXon 10th Anniversary Edition
events.venueName: Paragon Hall & Nex Hall, Siam Paragon / The River Club, Chao Phraya Riverside
events.summary: White Party Bangkok celebrates its 10th anniversary edition, AmaXon, from 29 December 2026 to 3 January 2027. Eventpop describes six days of events across Paragon Hall, Nex Hall, and The River Club.

events.title: Maho Rasop Series: Kings of Convenience by HAVE YOU HEARD?
events.summary: Maho Rasop Series and HAVE YOU HEARD? present Norwegian indie-folk duo Kings of Convenience at SiamPic Hall. The Bangkok show is confirmed for 1 December 2026.

events.title: Malcolm Todd: Do That Again Tour in Bangkok
events.summary: Live Nation Tero promotes Malcolm Todd’s Bangkok stop at UOB LIVE, Emsphere on 6 December 2026. Ticketmaster lists the show time as 7:00 PM.

events.title: DREAMING TOMOHISA YAMASHITA TOUR 2026 LIVE in BANGKOK
events.summary: Tomohisa Yamashita performs two Bangkok shows at Union Hall on 19 December 2026, with ThaiTicketMajor listing 14:00 and 19:00 performances. The official ticket page lists prices from 2,500 to 6,500 THB.

events.title: PANLAWAN ‘IN THE WILD’ Music Festival 2026
events.summary: A two-day nature-focused underground gathering outside Bangkok with a large Thai electronic lineup including .g, DJ Dragon, DJ Sweed, Elaheh, Jayja, Krit Morton, KPODKPOD and more, framed around music, art, nature and community.

events.title: NYE Boat Party
events.summary: Bangkok Island’s New Year cruise puts DJs, house and drum & bass on the Chao Phraya with a four-hour party boat, skyline/fireworks views and a countdown-oriented river dancefloor.

events.title: ELSEWHERE INVITES: Red Pig Flower, Mo & D.Rachan
events.summary: A serious after-hours house/minimal booking at Elsewhere, with Red Pig Flower joined by Mo and D.Rachan for a late Silom session rooted in micro-house, minimal house, techno and leftfield club sounds.

events.title: CENTARA POOL PARTY | Festive Edition
events.venueName: Pool Deck at Centara Grand at CentralWorld
events.summary: Bangkok Rooftops’ ninth Centara pool-party edition brings DJs, rooftop-pool dancing, sunset skyline energy and an optional Cru Champagne Bar after-party from the 26th to the 59th floor.

events.title: High Season 420 Fest 12–13 Dec
events.summary: Bangkok Island’s two-day riverside 420-community festival pairs live performances and a DJ stage with reggae, hip-hop, selecta and MC programming, plus a green market, food, art and cannabis flower competition.

events.title: MAHIRU ONE-MAN ASIA TOUR 2026-2027 "Auralisia" in Bangkok
events.summary: Singer-songwriter Mahiru brings the ONE-MAN ASIA TOUR “Auralisia” to Lido Connect Hall 3 on 12 December 2026. Ticketmaster lists the Bangkok concert at 7:00 PM, promoted by Live Nation Tero.

events.title: Elsewhere: DOTT, Raisoul, Drip
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok confirms DOTT, Raisoul, and Drip on Saturday 12 December 2026 from 11:30 PM. DOTT is a recurring figure in Bangkok’s house and underground club circuit.

events.title: FESTIVE ROOFTOP POOL PARTY - CENTARA GRAND BANGKOK
events.summary: Bangkok Rooftops hosts a festive pool party at Centara Grand at CentralWorld on 12 December 2026, with resident DJs from 3:00 PM to 10:00 PM and an afterparty moving to CRU Champagne Bar. Resident Advisor lists the genres as house and tech house.

events.title: Elsewhere: Jeff Chong, DOTT
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok confirms a Christmas-night club session with Jeff Chong and DOTT from 11:30 PM. The event is listed on the venue’s official programme for Friday 25 December 2026.

events.title: Pure Wax en Culture: DJ Mandol feat. VIM
events.summary: Culture Cafe hosts a vinyl-only underground session led by Córdoba/Lisbon selector DJ Mandol with VIM, spanning raw old-school techno, Latin percussion, house, minimal and electro in one of Bangkok’s intimate vinyl rooms.

events.title: Elsewhere: Serenne, IYY, Phill Prince
events.summary: Elsewhere Bangkok confirms a late-night club session with Serenne, IYY, and Phill Prince from 11:30 PM at its Silom venue. This is part of the venue’s December underground programme.
